lines: Colours the patch cables in the rack from the keyboard: its panel holds a list of cables, each with a colour and a key, and pressing that key while dragging a patch cable gives the cable that colour
Note — the keys are the number keys 1 to 9 until they are changed, and they act only while a patch cable is being dragged unless key mappings are always active
Note — once a cable is released the panel marks the colour that the next cable drawn in the rack will take

Note — the key left of the 1 key, the backtick on a US keyboard, switches latching on and off: latched, every new cable takes the colour last chosen; unlatched, the colour moves on one place each time
Note — right-clicking a cable on the panel opens its colour and its key for editing; holding the left button on a cable and then pressing a key assigns that key to it
Note — dragging a cable up or down the panel reorders the list, which is the order the colours cycle through
Note — the colours and keys are kept globally for the whole of Rack, and are written into patches and presets only when the two load and save options are turned on
Menu — Latch holds the chosen colour for the next cable created; with it off the colour cycles on after each cable
Menu — Use ` key to toggle latch mode lets the backtick key switch latching on and off
Menu — Indicate selected colour marks the currently chosen colour on the panel
Menu — Display key mappings prints each key beside the colour it selects
Menu — Port hover mode recolours every cable on a port when the cursor is over that port and a mapped key is pressed
Menu — Key mappings always active lets the keys work at any time, not only while a cable is being dragged
Menu — Load/save colours to/from patches/presets reads and writes the colours with patches and presets as well as globally
Menu — Load/save keys to/from patches/presets reads and writes the key assignments with patches and presets as well as globally
Menu — Key mappings opens the list of keys and their colours for editing
Menu — Replace patch cable colours recolours the cables already in the rack, one colour or all of them, to a chosen colour, at random, or in sequence by module
Menu — Add cable puts another cable on the panel to be given a colour and a key
Menu — Delete all cables clears every cable from the panel
CableColourKey.notes: The module has no parameters, inputs or outputs, so there is nothing on it to click for help beyond the panel itself; everything it does is done to the rack's cables and through its context menu. Inklen publish no source, and the panel is drawn in code rather than from an SVG — the installed res folder holds only a font. The maker's manual is the whole record here, read on 2026-09-12 against the installed 2.0.3.
